commits.message: Add order search, discount codes and order detail endpoint
Read session secret from env; add list_users test

pr.title: Order search, discount codes, and Stripe charging
pr.body:
Adds `GET /orders/search?q=&page=` (paginated, 1-indexed pages), discount codes on the order detail endpoint, and a `charge()` helper for Stripe. Also moves the session secret to an env var.

Testing: ran the service locally and searched for a few customers.
